turns.speaker: David
turns.text: Good morning everyone. Let's start with the pricing update for the new analytics dashboard.

turns.speaker: Zira
turns.text: Sure. The customer survey shows that most teams want a monthly plan instead of a yearly one.

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: That makes sense. Then we should launch the monthly plan first and keep the yearly plan for later.

turns.speaker: Zira
turns.text: Agreed. I will update the pricing page and send the draft to marketing by Friday.

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: Great. What about the mobile app? Is the login bug fixed yet?

turns.speaker: Zira
turns.text: Not yet. Ravi is working on it, and he expects a fix early next week.

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: Okay. Then we decide that the launch date moves to the twentieth of November.

turns.speaker: Zira
turns.text: Sounds good. I will tell the support team about the new launch date today.
